title: Peanut Crumble Granola
description: A delicious and crunchy granola made with peanuts and a nutty crumble topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together peanuts, nutty crumble, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together coconut oil, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and stir until everything is well combined.
Spread the mixture onto a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool completely.
Once cool, break the granola into chunks and serve.
